text: It can be tough to adjust to a new routine, especially when it involves missing a regular activity with a friend. One option is to keep the walking time in your schedule and decide whether to go alone or invite someone else to join you. You might also consider reaching out to your friend to see if they'd be open to arranging an occasional call or video chat. Keep in mind that their availability may change after the move, so it's a good idea to discuss and agree on a plan that works for both of you, rather than assuming a certain frequency.
